verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents server-side Filters & Rules, and community users describe building filters that sort incoming mail automatically. That is a genuine background automation, but the evidence is only page titles plus brief user mentions, and filters reportedly don't apply to existing mail. Scheduled Send and Snooze are one-off timed actions, not recurring autonomous automations. missing for 10: documented detail on rule triggers and actions, any recurring or scheduled automation, AI- or agent-driven autonomous workflows, and the ability to run automations on existing mail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Fastmail filters don't apply to existing emails
